error_found: QuotaDisplay 'Resets in N min' shows garbage: with x-ratelimit-reset=1786025416 (absolute epoch, ~56 min out; backend test test_rate_limit.py asserts epoch semantics) the UI rendered 'Resets in 29767091 min' (~56 years). frontend/src/components/QuotaDisplay.tsx does Math.ceil(rateLimits.reset / 60), treating the absolute epoch timestamp as seconds-remaining. Expected ~'Resets in 56 min'. The used/total bar itself is correct ('3 / 60 used (5%)'). Screenshot zfinal-APP-013-history.png.
notes: Progress bar from X-RateLimit-Remaining/Limit renders correctly; only the reset countdown math is wrong (reset epoch vs delta-seconds mismatch between backend and frontend).
